❗BETA, expect bugs and changes.

Welcome to ROT!  
An RNG-styled game combined with Tycoon mechanics, where your ultimate goal is to obtain the RAREST ore imaginable!

In this game you:
🏗️ Build droppers that drop random ores
🛠️ Use your ores to craft gears, modules, and brew potions to boost your luck!
♻️ Use gears and potions to find even rarer, larger ores, and repeat!

⭐With over 500 buttons, 60+ gears, 60 potions, and 125+ ores to discover! Can you collect them all?

- Join the group for a free Dropper!
- Join the Mars Sector group for +20% Luck and +10% Dropper speed!
   -> https://www.roblox.com/communities/35642607
- Premium user receives +5% Luck, +20% Cash and +2 Daily Quest Rerolls


Inspired by: Ore Tycoon, Resonation Excavation, Craftwars, and Sol's RNG
